Title: Virtual WAN Scale Unit name changes

Body.Content:
On June 1, 2019, the names for the Virtual WAN Scale Unit resource GUIDs will change. There won’t be a pricing impact from this change, but you will need to modify billing routines that rely on names.

For detailed changes, see the following table.

Service name
